name: Ecommerce Review Agent - Production Daily Classification (V2-M4)

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (9:07 AM)
nodes.notes: Production: runs daily at 9:07 AM Mon-Fri. For demo, disable and use Manual Trigger instead.

nodes.name: Manual Trigger (Demo)
nodes.notes: Use this for demo/testing. Disable Schedule Trigger above when using this.

nodes.name: Check Service Mode
nodes.notes: Pre-flight: verify service is running and check real/mock mode. If llm_mode='mock', tag results accordingly.

nodes.name: Read Reviews Source
nodes.notes: Generates 6 sample reviews for demo. Production: replace with API call or file read.

nodes.name: Split In Batches
nodes.notes: Split reviews into batches of 5. Each batch processes independently — one failing batch doesn't kill the run.

nodes.name: Call Analyze Batch API
nodes.notes: POST /api/v1/analyze_batch — sends batch of reviews to FastAPI for DeepSeek analysis. Timeout: 120s.

nodes.name: Validate Result
nodes.notes: Quality gate: validates batch response structure, required fields, mock/real consistency.

nodes.name: IF Human Review / High Priority
nodes.notes: Route: if needs_human_review_count > 0 → Feishu Alert path. Else → Daily Report path.

nodes.name: Build Feishu Alert Message
nodes.notes: Formats high-priority / human-review items into a Feishu interactive message card.

nodes.name: Send Feishu Bot (Placeholder)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER: Replace YOUR_FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL with actual Feishu bot webhook. No real token in template.

nodes.name: Generate Daily Report
nodes.notes: Generates a Markdown daily report from batch results for non-urgent items.

nodes.name: Output / Display Report
nodes.notes: Terminal node. Production: replace with Feishu Base API write, database insert, or file output.

description: V2-M4 Production workflow for ecommerce-review-agent. 12 nodes: Schedule Trigger + Manual Trigger → Check Mode → Read Reviews → SplitInBatches → Analyze Batch API → Validate → IF routing → Feishu Alert + Daily Report → Output. All URLs and tokens are placeholders — replace before production use. No secrets included. See n8n/workflow_design.md for full documentation.
